capabilities: Add skip forward and back buttons
Hold to temporarily change playback speed
Sync playback speed across open media
extras: Detailed settings, known limitations, and technical notes live in an external user guide rather than the README. Works on desktop and mobile (Obsidian 1.5.0+).
intentEvidence: A minimal enhancement toolbar layered on top of Obsidian's native HTML5 audio/video players
problem: Obsidian's native audio and video players lack playback speed controls and quick skip buttons.
summary: Toolbar that adds skip buttons, hold-to-speed, and a speed menu to Obsidian's native HTML5 audio and video players.
